gloss: naive; unworldly; inexperienced in the ways of the world

definitions.gloss: naive; unworldly; inexperienced in the ways of the world
definitions.explanation: A person who lacks knowledge of social norms, common sense, or how society works, often due to a sheltered upbringing.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世間知|せけんし}らずだ。
examples.english: That person is naive about the ways of the world.

examples.japanese: {世間知|せけんし}らず⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It can't be helped if people call you naive.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世間知|せけんし}らずで、いろいろ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I was young, I was naive about the world and made many mistakes.

notes:
Combines ⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧ (the world, society) with ⟦{知|し}ら→知る：00458_shiru⟧ず (not knowing). Functions both as a noun describing such a person and as a na-adjective-like descriptor. Carries a mildly critical tone, implying someone is out of touch with reality or social expectations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世間知|せけんし}らずな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a naive person
- {世間知|せけんし}らずだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}われる→思う：00492_omou⟧: to be seen as unworldly
- {世間知|せけんし}らず⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{嬢|じょう}さん→お嬢さん：01566_ojousan⟧: a sheltered young lady

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{箱入|はこい}り→箱入り：22842_hakoiri⟧⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧: sheltered daughter — specifically refers to a young woman raised in a protective environment, while {世間知|せけんし}らず applies to anyone regardless of gender
- ⟦{青二才|あおにさい}→青二才：22682_aonisai⟧: greenhorn — implies youthful inexperience with a more dismissive tone, while {世間知|せけんし}らず focuses on lack of social awareness
